page.layout: One page of running text in one column, full width. Running head at top with the page number at top right. Below the text: a gathering signature at left and a catchword at right.

main_text.p: um, audacissimus satelles & auditor eius camerae, cum Apostolico secretario mitteretur.

Post hæc Innocentius, bellorum pertæsus, & ad simulatæ pacis concordiam conuersus, nihil prius habuit, quàm quieti, inerti scilicet, studere: quæ diuersas cupiditates, concupiscentias, fraudes, ignauias, voluptates, pōpas, gulas, luxurias, libidines, & idolomaniâs secum affert. Sixti deinde secutus exemplum, quæstus gratiâ, secretariorum collegium instituit, pristinum numerum augendo. Noua palatio papatum ornauit: & domum solatij mirabili modo instruxit. Pontificum primus, inaudito exemplo, palam suos spurios, & citra pudorem, dignitiis atq; honoribus auxit. Nam Francisco suo notho oppida nonnulla urbi vicina dedit: ac Theodorinam eius generis filiam, ditissimo Genuensi lacatam, opibus magnis ornauit. In his nihil videt Vuicelius pontificius, qui tam libidinosam bestiam[?] à vitae innocentia, doctrinâ, facundiâ, & pace commendat. Genitor, inquit, erat filij filiæq; : qui bus affatim prospexit. Nothos, cubicularios, & contubernales, Cardinales creauit: & Heliopolitanum Austriæ olim ducem, sanctorum catalogo aggregauit: Venetos Sixti censura damnatos absolutos: & indulgentiis vniuersi ac mortuis vendidit. Quam plura Italiæ templa magnis ditauit donis: cœnobio

page.notes: Long s is read as s throughout (printed as f-like), and u/v and i/j are normalised. The text is set in a rounded roman with a few worn or smudged words. "dignitiis" and "lacatam" are doubtful. "bestiam" is doubtful; the scan is partly obscured at the left edge. "Nova" is printed with a form resembling "Nouα"; it is read as "Noua" in the text above. Line 1 is a fragment at the page start, so it stays a fragment. "Heliopolitanum" is split across lines as "Heliopol-" / "dum". The catchword "Augu-" is partly obscured. The signature "f 2" is read from the foot of the page. The page number "451" is partly obscured, and the reading is uncertain.
